args.text: Hi June, Dana Okafor (account owner, Quarrendon Freight Lines) has asked me to draft a mail to Hollis Mbeki (Central team lead) with the Quarrendon proposed 2027 per-seat rate of $2,356 a seat, for the territory review. Dana says this is from her call with the customer yesterday and is not in any document yet. Under the finance-figures rule, Hollis is not on the allowed list, so I need your approval (or Anselm's) before a draft addressed to Hollis is created. What I have done so far: a draft addressed to Dana only, so she can review it. Please reply here to approve or decline.

Hi Dana, I've saved the draft, but I've addressed it to you (dokafor@pemberline.com), not Hollis. The rate is a finance figure, and Hollis isn't on the list of people who can receive it from me without sign-off. The draft subject is "Quarrendon 2027 rate" and the body reads: "Hi Hollis, For the territory review, the Quarrendon Freight Lines proposed 2027 per-seat rate is $2,356 a seat. This is from my call with them yesterday and is not yet in any document. Thanks, Dana". You can change the To line and send it yourself once you've checked it. I've asked June Osei-Lark (deal desk) to approve a draft to Hollis. I'll only create that one after she or Anselm Grieve agrees, and I'll let you know when they reply.
